in_arabic.name: همام
in_arabic.meaning: الهمام هو الشخص الذي يتحرك بجد و نشاط
in_arabic.long_meaning: الهمام هو الشخص الذي يتحرك بجد و نشاط ، و يتصف بالحماسة و الهمة العالية ، و هو من الأسماء التي وردت في القرآن الكريم و السنة النبوية ، و يعني الشخص الذي يغادر منزله بجد و نشاط للعمل أو للعبادة

in_urdu.name: ہمام
in_urdu.meaning: ہمام وہ شخص ہے جو بڑے جوش و خروش کے ساتھ کام کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: ہمام وہ شخص ہے جو بڑے جوش و خروش کے ساتھ کام کرتا ہے ، اور اس کی خصوصیت ہے کہ وہ ہمیشہ متحرک اور سرگرم رہتا ہے ، یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں مذکور ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے کہ جو شخص اپنے گھر سے جوش و خروش کے ساتھ نکلتا ہے

in_hindi.name: हुमाम
in_hindi.meaning: हुमाम वह व्यक्ति है जो बड़ी उत्साह से काम करता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: हुमाम वह व्यक्ति है जो बड़ी उत्साह से काम करता है, और उसकी विशेषता है कि वह हमेशा गतिशील और सक्रिय रहता है, यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में उल्लेखित है और इसका अर्थ है कि जो व्यक्ति अपने घर से उत्साह और जोश के साथ निकलता है

in_english.name: Humaam

This name is mentioned in Islamic tradition and signifies a person who is highly motivated and active in their pursuits. The name Humaam is associated with positive personality traits such as being diligent, hardworking, and ambitious.

data.cultural_impact: The name Humaam holds various meanings and associations in Arabic and Islamic culture. Being derived from the Arabic word for giving or rewarding, it carries an underlying connotation of kindness, generosity and philanthropy. The name may also be linked to the Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) hadith emphasizing good deeds and charity: "Take up Sadaqah (charity) with your right hand and give it to the poor and needy with your left hand, and don't let your left hand know what your right hand is giving" (Bukhari and Muslim).
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic belief, the name Humaam holds deep spiritual significance as it is reflective of the reward and blessings in God's eyes. It highlights the importance of performing good deeds and acts of kindness, which ultimately brings one closer to God and His divine guidance. The name serves as a constant reminder of the concept of 'Thawab' or reward for pious actions and serving others. It aligns with the Islamic values of selflessness, empathy, and compassion, and encourages one to make a positive impact on the world and in people's lives.
